@Aceofheartss88 alright, here I am, so:

1. I remember watching the first fight between Conor and Max which was 2013 (I hate assuming, but since you assumed I know nothing about fighting, I’m automatically going to assume you were 5 years old in 2013, so deal with it😂😎). I haven’t rewatched it since but remember Conor wrestling a lot. Max is levels above that version of himself, and his volume is overwhelming for most guys. Conor McGregor is about to be 38, and between his age, number of serious training sessions or extended periods of training since 2021 that you can count on one hand, and the ring rust, he’s a shell of a fighter he once was, and isn’t a counter sniper.

2. Puncher’s chance is the most overused and overrated term in MMA. If anything, I’d argue Conor has more of a punchers chance against Charles than against Max. Obviously Max is less durable now, but he’s also less chinny than Charles and has way better boxing defense. Charles is super stationary, has dangerous offensive muay thai, but he’s very susceptible to boxing counters (even though I already said Conor’s not going to be a super quick counter striker). Charles gets tagged on the feet in every fight he has. Another thing, he’s an elite submission grappler, but not an elite wrestler. I don’t know what you’ve been watching but he won’t be able to take down Conor at will. Prime Khabib wasn’t able to do that against coked up Conor, and someone who’s 2 levels below Khabib in pure wrestling shouldn’t be able to do that, even though it will be easier as Conor gets more tired.

Now I still think both guys smash Conor in this day and age, I just wanted to give you educated reasoning that you don’t have to agree with, but I hope you can respect other people’s opinions without automatically having to be rude towards them, like that one fool over here who called another guy’s mom a ***** because he bet on a different fight outcome.

posts.author: A_Person_05
posts.content:
[Predictions]

McGregor vs. Holloway II
Max Holloway, TKO, R2
I’ll believe it when I see it. Here’s hoping they have a good backup for this. Hooker is always down to bang. I wouldn’t be opposed to Gamrot vs Max. Or maybe like Ruffy when he’s done beating up Chandler. As far as the prediction for this fight, McGregor will have a round of cardio tops probably less if we are being real, power never leaves, so maybe Max is a little safe in round one, but as soon as Round 2 comes Max is gonna finish McGregor in a similar fashion to the Pettis fight. This is sad, hate him or love him McGregor is a legend of the game, I’m gonna be sad watching him go out like this because it would just suck. I’ll be rooting for McGregor, I love Holloway but McGregor coming back and winning would be historic, it would be legendary, the post fight interview would be amazing, and we would get one more fight out of him, and it would mean he’s not that washed.

Saint-Denis vs. Pimblett
Paddy Pimblett, TKO, R2
I like Pimblett here. You gotta think after that ass whooping Gaethje gave him he’s worked on at least some type of takedown entry. But Paddy where he’s at in his career currently is just a better Moicano. A BJJ player with good enough striking but not great wrestling. I think Paddy can either force BSD to not kick for fear of being taken down, or catch kicks, or get him to the ground and dominate. I think on the feet this will be closer than you want to imagine. Look at BSD’s fights since losing to Poirier and Moicano. His striking looked like **** against Prepolec, against Ruffy he just spammed kicks, and shot takedowns, I don’t think he can spam kicks against Paddy because of the grappling, against Dariush he knocked him out with the first punch he threw, that isn’t exactly proof of good striking, and against Hooker on the feet he was getting ****** up, he just was. At this point BSD is a grappler who sprints forward throwing power shots to set up chain wrestling. He uses powerful body kicks because he doesn’t fear takedowns. What is gonna happen when he has to strike for the sake of striking, not just to set up takedowns, because he’s facing a better grappler? What happens when he can’t throw kicks with reckless abandon because he has to respect the threat of grappling? All the sudden BSD is pretty damn one dimensional, I don’t think he’s good enough at striking win this fight with so many of his weapons taken away. If you look at Gaethje, he wasn’t throwing any kicks, and he didn’t move backwards at all, Paddy took those weapons out of his arsenal with his own skill set and what he threatens, the difference between Gaethje and BSD is Gaethje IS good enough to win with those parts of his game taken away.

Sandhagen vs. Bautista II
Cory Sandhagen, DEC
Everything Bautista does Sandhagen does better. Genuinely. Offensive BJJ, Sandhagen can do everything Bautista does in scrambling, but Sandhagen can go and actually take people’s legs. And not in the lame ass gay hypothetical way that Ryan Hall can get someone’s leg, Sandhagen has actually taken the acls of not one but two great grapplers, TJ and Deiveson. Everything Bautista does on the feet, with the technical kickboxing, feints, switching stances, attacking the body at range, Sandhagen does with more speed, more activity, and is slicker, and has better entries and setups. Bautista maybe has a touch better power, but genuinely, who hits Sandhagen cleanly ever? Merab spamming random ******** doesn’t count because you can’t even read what someone doing when they sprint at you throwing shots from the hip. Deiveson didn’t land anything clean on Sandhagen, neither did Umar, Font certainly didn’t, neither did Vera, or TJ, or Aljo. Petr actually did, but Mario is not Petr.

Steveson vs. Ellison
Gable Steveson, TKO, R1
Idk who Ellison is, Gable is knocking him out inside 2.5 minutes. It won’t be close. I am excited to see an actual athlete in the heavyweight division, I think he goes far. I think he could beat like Derrick Lewis tomorrow if he wanted to.

Royval vs. Kavanagh
Brandon Royval, DEC
What a banger matchup. Peak Flyweight heater. Give me Royval in an upset. He’s gonna push pace, he lands big shots. I don’t think Loneer is gonna cripple him with leg kicks like he did to Moreno. Moreno also at this point of his career is just much worse than Royval. Royval 49-46ed Moreno, Royval beat Taira, Moreno got finished by Taira. Loneer doesn’t have the presence or power Kape has, he doesn’t throw with the output of Van, and he doesn’t have the dog needed to take Royval to decision. I think it’s gonna be very adjacent to the fight between Royval and Kai Kara France, Royval gets hurt, he scrambles, hurts Kavanugh, they dog it out for a bit, Royval pulls ahead, wins a decision.

Pinas vs. Almeida
Damian Pinas, TKO, R1
Holy banger. Absolute heater of a fight. Genuinely. As far as unranked matchups go, put this on the main card of any fight card you want, you won’t hear me complaining. I’m looking at that Abdul Razak AlHassan fight, which Almeida won, but he was getting his **** pushed in for 4 minutes of a 5 minute fight, it was about to be a 10-8. I think Pinas can land a big shot on Almeida at some point, and then finish the fight with more finesse than Abdul just wildly throwing with his hands at his waist, and his chin pointed at the roof.

Gandra vs. Reese
Ryan Gandra, TKO, R1
Reese sucks. He’s finishable on the feet and the ground, and this dude he’s fighting has finished a lot of fights in a row.

Durden vs. Osbourne
Ode Osbourne, TKO, R1
Durden’s beyond washed. Osbourne has power. And lands with power against everyone.

Garbrandt vs. Yanez
Adrian Yanez, TKO, R2
Banger. The boxing exchanges in the early portion of this fight will be so fun. Yanez is just so much younger and faster rn. I think Garbrandt could get chinned, but I’m picking him to survive, maybe win a round, and then lose a decision.

Kamaka III vs. Riley
Luke Riley, DEC
Riley decision that once again lowers his stock. He’s just not what UK MMA fans think he is. He’s a dog, but I don’t see the talent. He will beat this dude, but they can’t give him cans forever. When he fights up, I do believe he will lose. Like if they bumped him up the ranks after this fight against say Jose Delgado, Delgado is taking his chin home on a plate.

Whittaker vs. Krylov
Robert Whittaker, DEC
Whittaker wins with speed. I love this matchup for him. Krylov has looked so bad in his last few fights, he just charges at people with his hands out and his chin up, while also being quite slow. Whittaker is too quick and too slick for Krylov. I still really don’t think Whittaker is going to be a successful LHW, he’s just not big enough.

Cortez vs. Wang

WE will be watching Wang dominate this fight in every facet of MMA. WE will be watching Wang work her way to a title shot. And WE will be watching Wang knock out Shevchenko, and save women’s mma from that terrorist of the sport, that ruiner of cards.

posts.content:
Watching Chris Weidman talk about his leg break and everything that came after it honestly makes me feel even more like Max is going to win.
He explained how during the surgeries they basically had to damage the knee to repair the shin, inserting metal rods and all that, and how the tendons, ligaments, and muscles were heavily affected too. He said his injured leg is still noticeably smaller than the other one to this day.

What really stood out to me though was what he said about the mental side of it. Going into his comeback fight against Brad Tavares, he felt confident. No issues with the leg, felt ready to go. But the moment Brad kicked him, he instantly became hesitant to kick back, even though normally that would’ve been his automatic reaction.

Now, McGregor has a completely different mentality to Weidman, so it’s not a direct comparison. But hearing all that definitely makes me question whether Conor realistically has a chance, or if we’re all just holding onto the dream version of him.

Personally, I’m waiting for fight week before making any final judgment. I want to see how sharp he looks, how he talks, how he moves, how he hits pads, all of it. I really hope he comes in truly ready, because against Max, if you’re not fully there, he’s going to drown you.
